client: Meridian Foundation Reserve (fictional, Lab 13 common case) - Tobey Uhm's Project 2 mandate

objective.note: S2: CPI + 4% a year net of costs over rolling five-year periods. Tested ex ante as expected return net of trading costs >= CPI assumption + 4%.

AGG.name: iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF

LQD.name: iShares iBoxx $ Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF

risk_measure_note: S9 ('no calendar-year loss greater than 10%') had no measure in Lab 13. My mandate operationalises it as a one-year 95% parametric loss, -(expected return - 1.645 x volatility) <= 10% of the reserve, and monitors the realised worst calendar-year return. This interpretation needs CIO confirmation.

signal.name: Treasury term spread (10-year minus 3-month), known before the rebalance
signal.rule: If the spread is below 0 (inverted curve), move the constrained portfolio's IEF weight into BIL at the rebalance; otherwise keep IEF.

stop_conditions.note: STOP (hold the benchmark, report to committee) if (1) no portfolio passes the base mandate, (2) any single base-case-adjacent stress moves the portfolio by more than the 25% annual turnover limit, or (3) the walk-forward test shows a calendar-year loss worse than the 10% limit.
